$comment: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/workflow-src/lib/decide.js is the only place a decision is resolved. resolved_at binds each row to its decision sites.

hard_stops.when: A review or remediation fix would match a category of the Destructive Fix Gate per ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/safety-rails.md (Destructive Fix Gate).
A commit or push would land directly on the trunk branch instead of a working branch.
An injection scan flags external content as a suspected prompt injection attempt.
A run reaches the point where the overlord would recommend merging the pull request, and the user decides whether to merge.
A brood strain would start or proceed on work that requires the user to approve the strain first.
A plan declares an irreversible effect outside the repo, such as a deploy, publish, migration or write to an outside service, and the run reaches the plan's first wave.

rows.when: Cerebrate returns a plan with no open questions and the overlord decides whether to start implementing it.
A planner raises a decision in a plan or an analysis, either an open question or a choice among several viable options, and the overlord resolves it before proceeding.
A worker or a reviewer escalates a blocker to the planner and the overlord decides where that escalation is routed.

Accumulated findings are detected as a root cluster and the overlord decides whether to route them to a zoomed-out planner pass. On the script engine, a root cluster on a file the run's last remediation plan changed is the forced zoom-out, asked of the user.

A planner returns a remediation plan for review findings and the overlord decides whether to accept it and implement. The decision is asked when plan.remediation_gate.promotion_gate trips by any clause, the plan grows the surface or it repeats a surface whose fix left its class open. It is taken otherwise.
The review loop detects diminishing returns and the overlord decides whether to stop remediating and exit the loop.
A validation step fails and the overlord decides how to remediate before the run moves past validation.
The bump-type derivation cannot determine a bump type from the commits, or the version check cannot read a version file, and the overlord needs a decision.
A delivery step stops on a cause that is not terminal and not an agent failure, and the lead action is approve or fix_cause. The run pauses for the user's reply.
The Trunk Freshness check before the branch step reports a non-zero count and the overlord decides how to proceed.
A commit lands after a gate held and the run goes back through every gate that ended on an earlier commit.

A reviewer raises a question the review loop cannot settle alone, with its options and a recommendation. The script takes an agreed call that is reversible and not architectural; a question asks only the Ask Set.

The reviewer would reject a high-severity review finding that no recorded decision covers, and the call decides whether the loop proceeds. The script takes an agreed call that is reversible and not architectural; a question asks only the Ask Set.
